description: Colour grade, camera (zooms off, shake off, a punch-in), the shape (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5, or another output beside this one), a speaker cut-out with captions behind the head, and a replay of the whole video at a speed. Saves a new version, all or nothing; restore_version undoes it. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since. Left out: the live version, and a repeat is saved once.

pivot.description: [x, y] it zooms toward, fractions of the frame.

scale.description: How far in; 1.1 is a small punch-in.

captions_behind_head.description: Captions drawn behind the speaker (needs cut_out_speaker first).

cut_out_speaker.description: Cut the speaker out of the footage so things can go behind them; saved on its own.

saturation.description: 0 black and white, 1 as is, 2 vivid.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A Short, hook or shape of the video; the main video when left out.

replay.description: The whole video plays once, then again at this speed (5 is 5x); null takes the replay out. Saved on its own.

add.description: true keeps this shape and adds the new one as another output.

fit.description: subject follows the speaker, cover fills, contain keeps the whole picture.

x.description: cover: the window's centre across, -1 to 1.

y.description: cover: the window's centre down, -1 to 1.

shape.description: The video's shape; null puts its own back.

name: set_look

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_look result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change the picture
